conclusions.full_override: QWEN_SYSTEM_MD replaces base prompt, but append/context files can still be added
conclusions.identity_only: QWEN_SYSTEM_IDENTITY_MD changes leading identity, not full default prompt
conclusions.core_allowlist: tools.core/--core-tools allows only enumerated registered tools; settings and runtime behavior must be confirmed
conclusions.eager_not_allowlist: tools.eager defers schemas but does not itself deny tool registration
conclusions.model_override: only in owned public temporary files; private role/host effect still requires separate Agent Dispatch authority
conclusions.tool_search_disabled: tools.toolSearch.enabled=false explicitly denies tool_search and tool_call, leaving direct read_file allowlisted; source-verified, runtime effect must be independently observed
